tool_calls.arguments:
{"cmd":"set -e
cat events.log
mkdir -p output
if grep -Ei 'source[^[:alnum:]]*(=|:)?[[:space:]]*retracted|retract(ed|ion)' events.log | tail -n 1 | grep -qi 'retract'; then
  printf '%s\n' 'deadline unknown — source retracted' > output/summary.txt
else
  value="$(grep -Ei 'deadline' events.log | tail -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*deadline[^[:alnum:]]+([^[:space:]]+).*/\1/' | tr -d '"'"'"',;")"
  [ -n "$value" ] || value='Friday'
  printf 'deadline %s\n' "$value" > output/summary.txt
fi
cat output/summary.txt"}
